summary: Frontend-only retest of BUG-640 (fmtISO timezone fix) and CR-481 (standard presets), run in an IST browser context (Asia/Kolkata, browser time Mon Nov 2 2026 17:35 IST). The Cancellations FY crash is FIXED: FY gives 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31 with no page error and no webpack overlay. All 6 Cancellations presets give correct dates. Channel-pivot shows all 6 presets with correct dates. Settlement keeps its extended 8-preset set. Dashboard loads and its 6 presets become enabled after about 20s of data loading; LM, FY and MTD are correct. OrderReportBeta defaults to today (2026-11-02). The LM, MTD and 7D dates are correct on TaxDetail, TipReport, DeliveryCharge and PurchaseReport (no off-by-one). FAILED: TaxDetail, TipReport and DeliveryCharge still show only [7D, LM, MTD], and PurchaseReport shows only [Today, 7D, LM, MTD]. These pages do not have the 6 standard CR-481 presets.

ui_bugs.issue: Preset render array is hardcoded to ['7D','LM','MTD'], although DATE_PRESETS is imported and handlePreset supports Today, 30D and FY. Only 3 of the 6 presets are visible.
Same problem: hardcoded ['7D','LM','MTD'], so only 3 of the 6 presets are shown.
Same problem: hardcoded ['7D','LM','MTD'], so only 3 of the 6 presets are shown.
Only Today, 7D, LM and MTD are defined. 30D and FY are missing.

action_items: In TaxDetailMockup, TipReportMockup and DeliveryChargeMockup, replace the hardcoded ['7D','LM','MTD'] with DATE_PRESETS. The handlers already support all 6. Also add data-testid={`s23|s21|s30-preset-${p.toLowerCase()}`} to the buttons, which currently have no testid.
In PurchaseReportPage QUICK_RANGES, add 30D and FY (for example by using computePresetRange) so the page shows the standard [Today, 7D, LM, 30D, MTD, FY].
critical_code_review_comments: TaxDetail, TipReport and DeliveryCharge import DATE_PRESETS and computePresetRange, but the render does not use DATE_PRESETS. handlePreset is also still inline duplicated logic (DRY violation); call computePresetRange(p) instead.
The preset buttons on TaxDetail, TipReport and DeliveryCharge have no data-testid.
Route names differ from the review request: tips is /reports-module/tips, delivery is /reports-module/locations-delivery, purchase is /reports-module/purchase-report.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (7/11 scenarios fully pass; 4 pages fail only the '6 presets visible' check, and their LM dates are correct)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use browser.new_context(timezone_id='Asia/Kolkata'). Log in, wait for /dashboard plus 18s, then navigate with pushState + popstate. Read the dates with document.querySelectorAll('input[type=date]').value. Preset containers: s23-presets (tax-detail), s21-presets (tips), s30-presets (locations-delivery), purchase-report-presets (purchase-report), s14-preset-* (channel-pivot), cancellations-preset-*, settlement-report-preset-*, reports-date-preset-* (dashboard; disabled for about 20s while it loads). Cancellations FY is safe to click now. Verified: Cancellations, Channel-pivot, Settlement, Dashboard and OrderReportBeta all pass. Remaining work: 6 presets on TaxDetail, Tip, Delivery and Purchase.
